faqs.answer: Ayush builds agentic AI systems using LangGraph-style workflows — multi-step reasoning, tool use, and RAG for accurate portfolio and product chatbots.
Ayush uses RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) so chatbots answer from a curated knowledge base instead of guessing — that's how this assistant works too.
Ayush is open to AI Product Manager and GenAI roles. Check the Contact section or LinkedIn to get in touch.
